summary: The filing is a Form 8-K Item 8.01 Other Events reporting updates on a natural gas rate case filed by Public Service Company of Colorado, a subsidiary of Xcel Energy, with the Colorado Public Utilities Commission. It details intervenor testimony proposing adjustments to the initial $190 million revenue increase request, including CPUC Staff recommending a $15 million decrease and UCA recommending an $86 million increase. No special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or activism is involved; this is a routine regulatory proceeding.
